<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916086_theRebbe_759" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916086_theRebbe_759__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section contains the header and date of the maamar.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">B'Siyata Dishmaya.</t>
    <t s="1">Shabbos Parshas Vayeishev,</t>
    <t s="2">21 Kislev,</t>
    <t s="3">5731</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section notes that the text is an unedited draft.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">(Unedited draft)</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the three effects of Torah study for its own sake and elaborates on the concepts of peace, the heavenly and earthly retinues, and the building of palaces.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">Rabbi Alexandri said: Whoever engages in Torah study for its own sake makes peace in the heavenly retinue and in the earthly retinue.</t>
    <t s="1">Now, in the maamar beginning with these words that was said thirty years ago</t>
    <t s="2">(21 Kislev 5701)</t>
    <t s="3">it also brings the three opinions</t>
    <t s="4">(regarding the effect of engaging in Torah study for its own sake)</t>
    <t s="5">that follow</t>
    <t s="6">: It is as if he built palaces above and below,</t>
    <t s="7">it also protects the entire world,</t>
    <t s="8">it also brings the redemption closer.</t>
    <t s="9">And it explains in the maamar there,</t>
    <t s="10">that peace is the matter of connection</t>
    <t s="11">(meaning that there are two separate and distinct matters from each other,</t>
    <t s="12">and there is a third that makes peace between them),</t>
    <t s="13">and "retinue" (pamalya) means legions,</t>
    <t s="14">and in divine service it is the matter of the emotions (midos),</t>
    <t s="15">and this is: "Whoever engages in Torah study for its own sake makes peace in the retinue," etc.,</t>
    <t s="16">that through engaging in Torah study for its own sake he makes a connection in the emotions.</t>
    <t s="17">And it adds in the maamar there: And this refers to the emotions of the heart that are born from the emotions of the intellect</t>
    <t s="18">(the intention of this is to explain the two matters in the retinue,</t>
    <t s="19">the heavenly retinue and the earthly retinue,</t>
    <t s="20">that the heavenly retinue is the matter of the emotions of the intellect,</t>
    <t s="21">and the earthly retinue is the matter of the emotions of the heart.</t>
    <t s="22">For, behold,</t>
    <t s="23">the emotions are the root and source of the creations,</t>
    <t s="24">the seven days of construction,</t>
    <t s="25">and the intellects (mochin) are above the worlds,</t>
    <t s="26">as per the statement</t>
    <t s="27">"Two thousand years the Torah preceded the world,"</t>
    <t s="28">therefore, in general, the emotions are the aspect of "below" and the intellects are the aspect of "above,"</t>
    <t s="29">however, regarding the emotions themselves</t>
    <t s="30">(the retinue)</t>
    <t s="31">per se,</t>
    <t s="32">the emotions of the heart are the earthly retinue and the emotions of the intellect are the heavenly retinue).</t>
    <t s="33">And all this is the first effect of engaging in Torah study for its own sake.</t>
    <t s="34">And the second effect, "it is as if he built palaces," etc., is</t>
    <t s="35">(as explained in the maamar there)</t>
    <t s="36">the matter of the intellects,</t>
    <t s="37">and also in this there are two levels,</t>
    <t s="38">palaces above and palaces below,</t>
    <t s="39">the palaces above are the matter of the intellect in the brain,</t>
    <t s="40">and the palaces below are the matter of the intellect within the emotions,</t>
    <t s="41">as explained in the maamar there.</t>
    <t s="42">And this is also what, in the first effect, they said "makes peace in the retinue," etc.</t>
    <t s="43">(meaning that the retinue already exists beforehand, and he only makes peace within it),</t>
    <t s="44">and in the second effect they said "built palaces," which builds something new,</t>
    <t s="45">for the emotions,</t>
    <t s="46">since they are the root and source of the creations,</t>
    <t s="47">behold they exist in the worlds on their own accord</t>
    <t s="48">(and the effect done in them through engaging in Torah study for its own sake is the matter of peace),</t>
    <t s="49">but this is not the case with the intellects, which are above the worlds,</t>
    <t s="50">behold, the drawing down of the intellects through engaging in Torah study for its own sake is a matter of new building.</t>
    <t s="51">And it is known</t>
    <t s="52">that the creation of the worlds was for the sake of Yisrael and for the sake of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="53">for Yisrael is the matter of Zeir Anpin,</t>
    <t s="54">the emotions</t>
    <t s="55">(and as is known</t>
    <t s="56">that Yisrael is an acronym for "Yesh Shishim Ribo Osios LaTorah" (there are six hundred thousand letters to the Torah),</t>
    <t s="57">and it is known</t>
    <t s="58">that the number six hundred thousand is from the aspect of the emotions,</t>
    <t s="59">a vav being comprised of a yud, and a yud of a yud, etc.)</t>
    <t s="60">and Torah is the matter of the intellects,</t>
    <t s="61">and from this it is understood that through the two aforementioned effects accomplished through engaging in Torah study for its own sake</t>
    <t s="62">[makes peace in the retinue, etc.,</t>
    <t s="63">the aspect of emotions</t>
    <t s="64">(Yisrael),</t>
    <t s="65">and built palaces, etc.,</t>
    <t s="66">the aspect of intellects</t>
    <t s="67">(Torah)],</t>
    <t s="68">afterwards it also comes into the world that was created for the sake of Yisrael and for the sake of the Torah.</t>
    <t s="69">And this is the matter of the third effect</t>
    <t s="70">"it also protects the entire world,"</t>
    <t s="71">and as stated in the maamar: that the intellects and emotions protect the world, these being the actions performed through the attainment of the intellect and the emotions of the heart.</t>
    <t s="72">However, this effect that is done in the world,</t>
    <t s="73">that the intellects and emotions</t>
    <t s="74">(the aspects of Torah and Yisrael)</t>
    <t s="75">protect it,</t>
    <t s="76">is the perfection of the world as it is from the aspect of creation,</t>
    <t s="77">for the beginning of the world's creation was for the sake of Yisrael and for the sake of the Torah, as above,</t>
    <t s="78">however, the fourth effect of engaging in Torah study for its own sake,</t>
    <t s="79">"it also brings the redemption closer,"</t>
    <t s="80">is the matter of a perfection that is above the matter of creation,</t>
    <t s="81">and as stated in the maamar: that it changes in its very essence, etc.</t>
    <t s="82">And as is known</t>
    <t s="83">in the explanation of the Sages' statement</t>
    <t s="84">"All 'toldos' (generations/offspring) in Scripture are spelled deficiently, except for two: 'Eileh toldos hashamayim v'ha'aretz' (These are the generations of the heavens and the earth)</t>
    <t s="85">and 'V'eileh toldos Peretz' (And these are the generations of Peretz),</t>
    <t s="86">for although both of them are spelled fully,</t>
    <t s="87">nevertheless there is a great difference between them,</t>
    <t s="88">that "These are the generations of the heavens and the earth" is the matter of the aspect of perfection as it is from the aspect of creation,</t>
    <t s="89">but this is not the case with "And these are the generations of Peretz,"</t>
    <t s="90">the matter of the redemption,</t>
    <t s="91">it is an aspect of perfection that is above the matter of creation.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
